section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed, and unconfirmed: the group did not re-form reliably (stability 0.31). It is named only because a need points at it.
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into general multi-issue welfare advice (benefits, housing, health) and asylum, immigration and migrant advice.
Did not recur reliably when the data was resampled; it is named only because a need points at it, so treat the name as a proposal and the group as unconfirmed.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-219. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
